body:
CloudMicrophysics hard-codes the speed of the dendritic freezing front in its drop freezing for the P3 scheme. This PR adds it to `parameters.toml`, so that CloudMicrophysics can read it through ClimaParams, and bumps the version to 1.3.5.

New key:
- `dendritic_freezing_velocity` (0.5 m/s): the speed at which the dendritic freezing front crosses a supercooled drop after an ice embryo nucleates in it. Marked experimental.

No existing key changes.
title: Add the dendritic freezing velocity
